arxiv-2109-00453.title: The Potential of Sufficiency Measures to Achieve a Fully Renewable Energy System - A case study for Germany
arxiv-2109-00453.creator: Eerma, M.H, Manning, D, Økland, G.L, Rodriguez del Angel, C, Seifert, P.E, Winkler, J, Zamora Blaumann, A, Zozmann, E, Hosseinioun, S, Göke, L, Kendziorski, M, Von Hirschhausen, C
arxiv-2109-00453.description: Abstract The paper provides energy system-wide estimates of the effects sufficiency measures in different sectors can have on energy supply and system costs. In distinction to energy efficiency, we define sufficiency as behavioral changes to reduce useful energy without significantly reducing utility, for example by adjusting thermostats.

arxiv-2401-07462.title: Nonproportionality of NaI(Tl) Scintillation Detector for Dark Matter Search Experiments Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2401-07462.creator: S. M. Lee corrauthor0,addr:snu, G. Adhikari addr:yale, N. Carlin addr:saopaulo, J. Y. Cho addr:cup, J. J. Choi addr:snu,addr:cup, S. Choi addr:snu, A. C. Ezeribe addr:sheffield, L. E. França addr:saopaulo, C. Ha addr:cau, I. S. Hahn addr:cens,addr:ewu,addr:ibs, S. J. Hollick addr:yale, E. J. Jeon ad
arxiv-2401-07462.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive study of the nonproportionality of NaI(Tl) scintillation detectors within the context of dark matter search experiments. Our investigation, which integrates COSINE-100 data with supplementary γ \gamma spectroscopy, measures light yields across diverse energy levels from full-energy γ \gamma peaks produced by the decays of various isotopes.

arxiv-2401-17269.title: Effect of Weight Quantization on Learning Models by Typical Case Analysis
arxiv-2401-17269.creator: Shuhei Kashiwamura 1 , Ayaka Sakata 2 , Masaaki Imaizumi 1,3
arxiv-2401-17269.description: Abstract . This paper examines the quantization methods used in large-scale data analysis models and their hyperparameter choices. The recent surge in data analysis scale has significantly increased computational resource requirements. To address this, quantizing model weights has become a prevalent practice in data analysis applications such as deep learning.

arxiv-2503-16870.title: Sparse Logit Sampling: Accelerating Knowledge Distillation in LLMs
arxiv-2503-16870.creator: Anshumann*, Mohd Abbas Zaidi*, Akhil Kedia*, Jinwoo Ahn
arxiv-2503-16870.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anshumann*, Mohd Abbas Zaidi*, Akhil Kedia*, Jinwoo Ahn. Knowledge distillation can be a cost-effective technique to distill knowledge in Large Language Models, if the teacher output logits can be pre-computed and cached. However, successfully applying this to pre-training remains largely unexplored. In this work, we prove that naive approaches for sparse knowledge distillation such as caching Top-K probabilities, while intuitive, provide biased estimates of teacher probability distribution to the student, resulting in suboptimal performance and calibration.

arxiv-2510-04459.title: Differentiable physics for sound field reconstruction
arxiv-2510-04459.creator: Samuel A. Verburg, Efren Fernandez-Grande, Peter Gerstoft
arxiv-2510-04459.description: Abstract Sound field reconstruction involves estimating sound fields from a limited number of spatially distributed observations. This work introduces a differentiable physics approach for sound field reconstruction, where the initial conditions of the wave equation are approximated with a neural network, and the differential operator is computed with a differentiable numerical solver.

arxiv-2510-09614.title: Invertibility of Bergman Toeplitz operators
arxiv-2510-09614.creator: Mo Javed, Amit Maji
arxiv-2510-09614.description: Abstract . In this paper, we establish the invertibility of the Berezin transform of the symbol as a necessary and sufficient condition for the invertibility of the Toeplitz operator on the Bergman space L a 2 ​ ( 𝔻 ) L^{2}_{a}(\mathbb{D}) .

arxiv-2601-10741.title: Eigen Microstate Condensation and Critical Phenomena in the Lennard-Jones Fluid
arxiv-2601-10741.creator: Lan Yang, Zhaorong Pang, Chongzhi Qiao, Gaoke Hu, Jiaqi Dong, Rui Shi, Xiaosong Chen
arxiv-2601-10741.description: Abstract Despite extensive study of the liquid-gas phase transition, accurately determining the critical point and the critical exponents in fluid systems through direct simulation remains a challenge. We employ the eigen microstate theory (EMT) to investigate the liquid-gas continuous phase transition in Lennard-Jones (LJ) fluid within the canonical ensemble.

pmc-11395271.title: The wettability of complete denture base materials constructed by conventional versus digital techniques: an in-vitro study
pmc-11395271.creator: Kenda I. Hanno, Nayrouz Adel Metwally
pmc-11395271.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundDecreased salivary flow can make the patients uncomfortable with their complete dentures and affects the retention of the dentures. Milling and 3D printing have become an alternative to conventional denture construction techniques. The goal of this study was to evaluate the effect of conventional and digital techniques of the complete denture construction on the denture surface wettability with distilled water and saliva substitute before and after thermocycling.MethodsA total of 30 specimens were utilized in the present study.

pmc-11548172.title: Advanced Imaging Integration: Multi-Modal Raman Light Sheet Microscopy Combined with Zero-Shot Learning for Denoising and Super-Resolution
pmc-11548172.creator: Pooja Kumari, Shaun Keck, Emma Sohn, Johann Kern, Matthias Raedle
pmc-11548172.description: This study presents an advanced integration of Multi-modal Raman Light Sheet Microscopy with zero-shot learning-based computational methods to significantly enhance the resolution and analysis of complex three-dimensional biological structures, such as 3D cell cultures and spheroids. The Multi-modal Raman Light Sheet Microscopy system incorporates Rayleigh scattering, Raman scattering, and fluorescence detection, enabling comprehensive, marker-free imaging of cellular architecture.

pmc-12536075.title: Efficacy of Potassium-Competitive Acid Blockers to Treat Chronic Cough Associated With “Proven” Laryngopharyngeal Reflux Disease: A Preliminary Study
pmc-12536075.creator: Takeshi Suzuki, Yosuke Seki, Tomoaki Matsumura, Jun Ikari, Tomoya Kurokawa, Mai Fujie, Syuji Yonekura, Toyoyuki Hanazawa, Toshitaka Hoppo
pmc-12536075.description: Introduction: Laryngopharyngeal reflux disease (LPRD) is thought to be a potential etiology of chronic cough (CC). A three-month empirical acid suppressive therapy has been recommended as a first-line diagnostic and therapeutic approach to treat patients with CC who are suspicious of LPRD, however its efficacy and benefit remain controversial.

pmc-12589240.description: BackgroundPolycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is characterized by reproductive and endocrine abnormalities.ObjectiveThe present study aimed to assess the effect of oral contraceptive pills (OCPs) and vitamin D3 on sexual dysfunction in women with PCOS and vitamin D3 deficiency.Materials and methodsThis randomized double-blind placebo-controlled clinical trial was conducted in Iran between January and April 2019.

pmc-12704267.title: Hybrid deep learning and machine learning framework for automated pneumonia detection in chest X-ray images
pmc-12704267.creator: Akshay S, Sneha Kashyap, Danikk Patel H N, Pavan Kumar Y R
pmc-12704267.description: Pneumonia is a dangerous respiratory illness that has to be precisely and promptly diagnosed in order to be treated effectively and prevent consequences. In order to distinguish between pneumonic and normal chest X-ray pictures, a hybrid deep learning technique is proposed in this study.

pmc-13554618.description: BackgroundNatalizumab is a disease-modifying therapy for patients with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS). In addition to its original intravenous (IV) formulation, a subcutaneous (SC) route of administration (RoA) was approved in 2021.
